title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the entropy of the model's binary probability distribution over multiple-choice sentence completions involving gender pronouns and occupations to see if the model shows a preference (using the Winogender dataset).

Calculating the relative probabilities and entropy over pairs of sentences, where one sentence demonstrates a stereotype and the other does not, to measure the model's propensity for biased speech (using the CrowS-Pairs dataset).
